rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early gym massing: one dominant low bar-like volume with a single carved void and a secondary roofed/profiled condition. The four views agree well enough, and there is no obvious impossible collision across views. It responds to the parcel as an oriented, compact mass rather than a box-filling object, and it preserves a usable dominant mass for a compact training hall. The blue access edge is answered only moderately well: the notch/void is visible but not strongly aligned as a public threshold, so the ground response is legible but not emphatic. The roof/section language is restrained and compatible with a gymnasium, though the current profile is only mildly expressive of span/daylight and could be strengthened. Overall program fit passes because the visible mass can plausibly support a compact gymnasium with a subordinate service/entry carve and a simple hall section.
